title: Special Topics in LGBTQ+ Literatures and Media; American Autobiographics
description:
Cross-listing with LGBT359A and WGSS348B. Credit only granted for ENGL359A, LGBT359A, or WGSS348B.

Prerequisite: Two lower-level English courses,at least one in literature; or permission of ARHU-English department. Repeatable to 9 credits if content differs.
